title: CR-009 Golden Seam — Controlled Whole-Image Revision
description: Source-conditioned whole-image revision of the verified CR-007 Porcelain Echo photograph: revise the attached existing vase image by adding one restrained gold-lacquer repair seam on the visible upper-right shoulder while semantically prioritizing preservation of silhouette, cobalt portrait decoration, motifs, camera, lighting, and studio background. Uses installed route reference_transform with symbolic roles only; no TransformationPack, no mask/ROI fields, and no claim of pixel-exact outside-region preservation. Operator must supply the verified CR-007 PNG (SHA-256 15b082d7573ee973740553d463aa2693634fcc45a6d0a4d8538dd5e0c4dcbc97) as the image to edit at generation time. Distinct from blocked CR-008 localized editing. See docs/CR_009_GOLDEN_SEAM.md. No gallery image attached.

semantic_spec.request: Edit the attached existing photograph of one free-standing blue-and-white porcelain vase—do not invent an unrelated new vase or a different composition. Revise that same product photograph by adding one narrow, irregular gold-lacquer repair seam on the visible upper-right shoulder of the vessel (viewer’s right), away from the painted figure’s face. Treat the seam as a fictional contemporary lacquer join finished with restrained metallic gold powder following the vessel curvature—not floating ornament, not a decorative gold network, and not extensive gilding. Optionally allow one short secondary branch only if fracture geometry clearly justifies it. Keep the result a recognizable whole-image revision of the attached source: preserve the original vase silhouette, rim opening, neck, shoulders, belly curvature, foot, and contact shadow; preserve the cobalt underglaze portrait (facial profile, upswept hair with floral ornament, layered painted garments), floral motifs, and existing corridor-style architectural decoration already present on the vessel; preserve the quiet studio background, soft directional lighting, camera framing, perspective, and 4:5 composition as closely as a whole-image edit without masks allows. Do not redesign the figure, repaint the cobalt decoration wholesale, introduce additional cracks or chips elsewhere, change the porcelain into marble/metal/glass, add logos, text, dynasty marks, or decorative gold borders. This is semantic preservation guidance for a whole-image edit, not a pixel-exact or masked local edit.
